## 11. Fit tests [All] [Core]

Main points:
- Seven long steps [Seed]
- Seven detailed items [Seed]
- One line picks the shape (2) [Seed]

### 11.1 Seven long steps [All] [Seed]
Layout: process
- Map: list the coverage dimensions for the topic
- Research: search the authoritative sources first
- Draft: write version zero point one
- Refine: revise sections by their numbers
- Review: check it in a fresh chat
- Approve: record the gate decision
- Build: assemble and check the deck

### 11.2 Seven detailed items [All] [Seed]
Layout: list
- Brief: who attends, why now and how long the session runs
- Seeds: transcripts, notes and earlier outlines worth mining
- Research: official documentation and primary sources first
- Outline: numbered sections that map straight to slides
- Review: a fresh chat that isn't anchored to earlier drafts
- Approval: an explicit decision recorded in the decisions log
- Deck: one build from the approved outline, then checks
